🎵 YouTube Music ReVanced (RVX) Builder

Patched version of YouTube Music with background playback, ad-free experience, AMOLED dark theme, maximum audio bitrate, and premium features powered by Morphe CLI & Anddea Patches.

--- ## 📌 About This repository provides an automated CI/CD cloud build pipeline and system module for **YouTube Music ReVanced (RVX)**. Supports both usage variants: - 🌈 **Non-Root (Standalone APK)**: Works on any Android device without root privileges via MicroG / GmsCore. - 🎭 **Root (Magisk / KernelSU / APatch Module)**: Directly bind-mounts over the official YouTube Music installation without modifying system partitions and without requiring a reboot (Instant Hot-Mount). --- ## ✨ Features - 🎧 **Background Playback**: Keep listening with the screen turned off or while using other apps without a YouTube Premium subscription. - 🚫 **Ad-Free**: Audio ads, video ads, and in-app banner promotions are completely removed. - ⚡ **Always High Bitrate**: Forces the highest audio stream quality by default. - 🎤 **Synchronized Lyrics (Third-Party Lyrics)**: Karaoke-style synced lyrics in the player panel powered by 15+ external lyric providers. - 🔀 **Track Crossfade**: True dual-player seamless audio crossfade between consecutive tracks. - 🚗 **Android Auto Support**: Certificate spoofing enabled to ensure playback works on car dashboards. - 🛡️ **SponsorBlock**: Automatically skip non-music segments, intros, and outros in music videos. - 👎 **Return YouTube Dislike**: Displays dislike counts on tracks and music videos. - 🖤 **AMOLED Pure Black Theme**: Deep `#000000` pitch black theme for battery savings on OLED/AMOLED displays. - 🔄 **Daily Automated Updates**: Automatically checks for new YouTube Music versions and patches every day, building and publishing fresh releases when available. --- ## 📥 GmsCore / MicroG Downloads (For Non-Root Users) To log into your Google Account in the **Non-Root** version, install **GmsCore (MicroG)**: | Source | Download Link | |---|---| | **MicroG-RE (Morphe)** (Recommended) | 🔗 [Download](https://github.com/MorpheApp/MicroG-RE/releases/latest) | | **MicroG-RE (wstxda)** | 🔗 [Download](https://github.com/wstxda/microg-re/releases/latest) | | **ReVanced GmsCore** | 🔗 [Download](https://github.com/revanced/gmscore/releases/latest) | --- ## 🚀 Installation Guide ### 🌈 Method 1: Non-Root (No Root Required) 1. Install **GmsCore (MicroG)** from the links above. 2. Go to the [Releases](../../releases) section of this repository. 3. Download **`YouTubeMusic.RVX.v-NonRoot.apk`**. 4. Install the APK and launch it. 5. Log into your Google Account and enjoy! --- ### 🎭 Method 2: Root (Magisk / KernelSU / APatch) 1. Ensure the official YouTube Music app is installed from the **Google Play Store**. 2. Go to the [Releases](../../releases) section and download **`YouTubeMusic.RVX.v.zip`**. 3. Open your root manager app (**Magisk**, **KernelSU**, or **APatch**). 4. Navigate to the **Modules** tab ➔ tap **Install from storage** ➔ select the downloaded `.zip` file. 5. The module mounts immediately without requiring a reboot! --- ## ⚙️ Triggering a Manual Build 1. Open the [Actions](../../actions) tab in this repository. 2. Select **`Build & Package YouTube Music RVX`** from the left sidebar. 3. Click **`Run workflow ▾`** ➔ Click the green **`Run workflow`** button. 4. In 3–4 minutes, new builds will be published directly to [Releases](../../releases). --- ## 🛠️ Troubleshooting - **"App not installed / Package incompatible" error during Non-Root install**: Uninstall your previous YouTube Music RVX version first before installing the new build. - **Playback buffering or song loading issues**: Go to *Settings > RVX > Misc > Spoof client* and switch to a different streaming client. - **Root module not taking effect**: Make sure the installed Play Store version matches the module version, or tap the **Action** button on the module card in Magisk. --- ## 📜 Credits & Acknowledgments - 🛠️ [Anddea Patches](https://github.com/anddea/revanced-patches) - ⚙️ [Morphe CLI](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-cli) - 📺 [ReVanced Team](https://github.com/revanced) - 💡 [Zy0x/YouTube-Revanced](https://github.com/Zy0x/YouTube-Revanced) for architectural inspiration

🇬🇧 English | 🇷🇺 Русский

🎵 YouTube Music ReVanced (RVX) Builder

Patched version of YouTube Music with background playback, ad-free experience, AMOLED dark theme, maximum audio bitrate, and premium features powered by Morphe CLI & Anddea Patches.

---

📌 About

This repository provides an automated CI/CD cloud build pipeline and system module for YouTube Music ReVanced (RVX).

Supports both usage variants:

  • 🌈 **Non-Root (Standalone APK)**: Works on any Android device without root privileges via MicroG / GmsCore.
  • 🎭 **Root (Magisk / KernelSU / APatch Module)**: Directly bind-mounts over the official YouTube Music installation without modifying system partitions and without requiring a reboot (Instant Hot-Mount).

    • ---

    ✨ Features

  • 🎧 **Background Playback**: Keep listening with the screen turned off or while using other apps without a YouTube Premium subscription.
  • 🚫 **Ad-Free**: Audio ads, video ads, and in-app banner promotions are completely removed.
  • ⚡ **Always High Bitrate**: Forces the highest audio stream quality by default.
  • 🎤 **Synchronized Lyrics (Third-Party Lyrics)**: Karaoke-style synced lyrics in the player panel powered by 15+ external lyric providers.
  • 🔀 **Track Crossfade**: True dual-player seamless audio crossfade between consecutive tracks.
  • 🚗 **Android Auto Support**: Certificate spoofing enabled to ensure playback works on car dashboards.
  • 🛡️ **SponsorBlock**: Automatically skip non-music segments, intros, and outros in music videos.
  • 👎 **Return YouTube Dislike**: Displays dislike counts on tracks and music videos.
  • 🖤 **AMOLED Pure Black Theme**: Deep `#000000` pitch black theme for battery savings on OLED/AMOLED displays.
  • 🔄 **Daily Automated Updates**: Automatically checks for new YouTube Music versions and patches every day, building and publishing fresh releases when available.

    • ---

    📥 GmsCore / MicroG Downloads (For Non-Root Users)

    To log into your Google Account in the Non-Root version, install GmsCore (MicroG):

    | Source | Download Link |

    |---|---|

    | MicroG-RE (Morphe) (Recommended) | 🔗 Download |

    | MicroG-RE (wstxda) | 🔗 Download |

    | ReVanced GmsCore | 🔗 Download |

    ---

    🚀 Installation Guide

    🌈 Method 1: Non-Root (No Root Required)

  • Install **GmsCore (MicroG)** from the links above.
  • Go to the [Releases](../../releases) section of this repository.
  • Download **`YouTubeMusic.RVX.v-NonRoot.apk`**.
  • Install the APK and launch it.
  • Log into your Google Account and enjoy!

    • ---

    🎭 Method 2: Root (Magisk / KernelSU / APatch)

  • Ensure the official YouTube Music app is installed from the **Google Play Store**.
  • Go to the [Releases](../../releases) section and download **`YouTubeMusic.RVX.v.zip`**.
  • Open your root manager app (**Magisk**, **KernelSU**, or **APatch**).
  • Navigate to the **Modules** tab ➔ tap **Install from storage** ➔ select the downloaded `.zip` file.
  • The module mounts immediately without requiring a reboot!

    • ---

    ⚙️ Triggering a Manual Build

  • Open the [Actions](../../actions) tab in this repository.
  • Select **`Build & Package YouTube Music RVX`** from the left sidebar.
  • Click **`Run workflow ▾`** ➔ Click the green **`Run workflow`** button.
  • In 3–4 minutes, new builds will be published directly to [Releases](../../releases).

    • ---

    🛠️ Troubleshooting

  • **"App not installed / Package incompatible" error during Non-Root install**:

    • Uninstall your previous YouTube Music RVX version first before installing the new build.

  • **Playback buffering or song loading issues**:

    • Go to *Settings > RVX > Misc > Spoof client* and switch to a different streaming client.

  • **Root module not taking effect**:

    • Make sure the installed Play Store version matches the module version, or tap the Action button on the module card in Magisk.

    ---
